---
title: A fixture that declares an exit status
description: Three shell-neutral steps, the middle one declaring the status it must end with.
quickstart: true
---

## A step that must succeed

```console
ptah version
```

## A step that must fail

The status is the point of the command rather than a fault in it, which is what
`exits=` says:

```console exits=1
ptah schema drift --schema-file schema.sql --db-url "sqlite://app.db"
```

## A step that must succeed again

The run continues past a step whose declared status was met:

```console
ptah version
```
